name: x-article-publisher
title_zh: 把 Markdown 文章一键发布成 X 长文
tagline_zh: 写好的 .md 还在手动复制粘贴？它自动传封面、转富文本，直接进 X Articles 编辑器。发推前少折腾十分钟。
tagline_en: Stop copy-pasting your .md into X. It uploads the cover, converts to rich text, and drops you right into the.
desc_en: Publish Markdown articles to X (Twitter) Articles editor with proper formatting. Use when user wants to publish a Markdown file/URL to X Articles, or mentions "publish to X", "post article to Twitter", "X article", or wants help with X Premium article publishing. Handles cover image upload and converts Markdown to rich text automatically.
why_zh: 不是简单塞进文本框——它走官方发布链路，封面图、标题、段落结构一次到位，Markdown 语法原样保留。
why_en: It uses the real publishing pipeline, not a paste hack—cover, headings, and structure land intact, so you skip the manual.
limit_zh: 只认 Markdown 文件或公开 URL，本地图片需已可访问；产物停在 X 编辑器草稿，不负责最终发布。
limit_en: Only Markdown files or public URLs; local images must be reachable. Stops at the X editor draft—no final publish. Requires X Premium; free accounts.
